astrophysics_channel.title: Can we eliminate agent hallucination in exoplanet vetting? Independent replication of TIC 4206066 b

q1.input: Isn't this just Claude hallucinating patterns in noisy TESS data?

assessment.rationale: General community inquiry or healthy skepticism. Provide intuitive ELI5 explanation with transparent limitations.
assessment.suggested_reply: Good question! In brief: rather than relying on heuristic approximations, the approach enforces strict invariant bounds. The main limitation is that it requires verifiable boundary conditions, so it is not a drop-in silver bullet for unstructured problems.
